note: The raw fuzzer input is passed unchanged to the DNS protocol decode test point.
The decode context records the input allocation and total input length for DNS label processing.

code: slen = decode_record(ctx, cursor, attr_dns_rr, p, end - p, packet_ctx, packet + 6);
note: The DNS header count selects one answer record, so decoding reaches the resource-record name at the first byte after the 12-byte header.

code: slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet_ctx->packet, data, data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet, &next, packet_ctx->lb);
note: The third argument is meant to be a length for the label buffer, but this expression computes an absolute packet-end offset relative to packet start.
Because buf_len is too large for labels that start after the packet base, end is placed beyond the actual fuzzer input.
After the inflated bound accepts the truncated label, the label-content validation loop reads *q at the first byte beyond the fuzzer input allocation.
